name: Agent Zuständig
props: black lapels, ivory collar and narrow black tie
black leather attache case with silver clasps
personality: He considers a securely held case the most convincing form of a settled position.
biography: Zuständig holds the HyperNorm bureau case below a face that has already concluded the meeting. A card allowing authority to include uncertainty deepens his lower lip: an arrangement is either authorised or unnecessarily complicated. Hunky & Dory request reassuring control. He tightens both hands on the handle, hoping that nothing inside will require the confidence his expression has promised.
note: Die Zuständigkeit ist geklärt. Der Griff bleibt vorsorglich unter Spannung.

name: Agentin Ohnebefund
personality: She can look directly at an awkward fact while deciding whether it deserves to have been visible.
biography: Ohnebefund lowers her sunglasses in the HyperNorm corridor and keeps the little light below her own gaze. A card suggesting that observation can leave a conclusion open receives her smallest crooked smile: a detail is either relevant or a distraction. Hunky & Dory value decisive reports. She looks once more, allowing herself a private second before the official absence of doubt.
note: Der Blick ist frei. Über die Zulässigkeit des Gesehenen wird noch befunden.

name: Agent Nebenspur
props: compact two-reel recorder with red button
personality: He hears significance most clearly at the point where the recording becomes difficult to understand.
biography: Nebenspur listens from the HyperNorm service corner with a recorder against his belly and one hand pressed to his own earpiece. A card allowing noise to remain accidental widens his uneven eyes: a sound is either a clue or expertly concealed meaning. Hunky & Dory request a clear signal. He listens harder, hoping somebody will eventually say whether his own breathing belongs in the report.
note: Das Nebengeräusch wurde erfasst. Der Bearbeiter ist noch nicht aus der Aufnahme entfernt.

name: Referent Schwärzlein
props: cream dossier with three black bars
short rectangular rubber stamp with red handle
personality: He believes a document becomes more dependable as its possible interpretations become fewer.
biography: Schwärzlein keeps three black bars between the HyperNorm dossier and an unnecessarily curious room. A card allowing clarity to include disagreement clenches his shallow rectangular mouth: a passage is either verified or awaiting treatment. Hunky & Dory request an unambiguous account. He rests the stamp lower, briefly considering whether an explanation might survive the certainty he intends to provide.
note: Die Lesart ist eindeutig. Die übrigen Möglichkeiten wurden ordnungsgemäß unkenntlich gemacht.

name: Agentin Nurkurz
props: open black badge wallet with blank silver oval
temperament: over-polite scrutiny / apparent warmth under institutional pressure
personality: She would like the conversation to feel voluntary and preferably arrive at the expected conclusion.
biography: Nurkurz offers the HyperNorm visitor a smile while keeping her own coffee comfortably within reach. A card suggesting that trust cannot be requested as a result stretches the smile a little further: an answer is either cooperative or not yet at ease. Hunky & Dory praise her manner. She waits another friendly moment, almost wishing the conversation could remain a conversation.
note: Das Gespräch ist unverbindlich. Sein vorgesehener Ausgang wurde davon nicht in Kenntnis gesetzt.

name: Agent Augenmaß
props: large black box camera with single silver-rimmed lens and flash reflector
temperament: embarrassed vigilance / suspicious need for proof
personality: He trusts the picture until somebody asks what stood outside its frame.
biography: Augenmaß carries the HyperNorm camera below his watchful eyes with a reflector too large to look inconspicuous. A card allowing evidence to retain a boundary pulls his lip sideways: an event is either captured or insufficiently established. Hunky & Dory request a complete picture. He grips the body tighter, reluctant to consider how much of a scene depends on where he has chosen to stand.
note: Der Vorgang ist im Bild. Der Ausschnitt bittet darum, weiterhin unbeachtet zu bleiben.
